rational_shears.scope: Algebraic factors and modular shears only; no tape execution time tested.

synthetic_transforms.scope: Character cancellation and retained bit-reversal layout; no fast simultaneous-layer or integer multiplication complexity certified.

cardinality_network.scope: All simple graphs through four vertices, including isolates and zero-cardinality cases; no fast matching solver tested.

degree_paths.scope: All simple graphs through five vertices without isolates; isolates are a separate immediate infeasibility case.

curvature_telescope.scope: Abstract curvature/mass budget; source alignment and warmup hypotheses are not tested.

block_entropy.scope: Product-of-block-simplex models, exact softmax maximizers; arbitrary constrained action hulls use the selected proof.

priority_lists.scope: Carry and one-sided pruning order only; no global scheduling hierarchy constructed.

boundary_capacity.scope: Three-slot capacity conditional on disjoint upsets and successor witnesses; source global boundary invariants are not certified.

limitations: Selected exact identities, reductions and finite models only; no claimed global algorithm or running time certified; no Lean build.
